summary: Tested the Conveyancing Companion end to end: backend pytest (10/10 passed) and a Playwright UI run at mobile 390x844 with the free user test@advocate.app and the admin. All requested flows work: CRUD, ownership 404, 401 without auth, suggestion format, the 3-free limit then 402, unlimited for admin, tile and modal, disclaimer, sell and buy moves, stage toggle, notes and address that persist after closing and reopening, TA6/TA10/TA7 tabs, Suggest wording, Use as my answer (copies only the Suggested wording part, without the checklist or ** markers), answers that persist, PDF download (POST /api/pdf/inline 200, TA6-draft-answers.pdf), no forms tab on buy moves, conv-free-left counter (hidden for admin), 402 toast plus the subscription modal, and delete with the confirm dialog. 5 real LLM calls in total. One design issue: the modal has no inner padding on mobile.

issues: The .modal-card class has no padding, and ConveyancingModal does not add any. The title, disclaimer, 'I'm selling/I'm buying' buttons, address input, stage cards and form tabs touch the left and right screen edges. Other modals, such as the subscription sheet, use about 18px padding. Fix: add padding: '18px 18px calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))' to the modal-card style in Conveyancing.js.
The inline maxHeight '92%' overrides the shared 86% cap. The sheet nearly fills the screen, so there is little backdrop left to tap to close. Minor.

action_items: Add horizontal and bottom padding to the Conveyancing modal card (Conveyancing.js line ~185) so content is not flush with the screen edges on mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: conv_delete / remove(): the frontend swallows delete errors (.catch(() => {})), so if the delete fails the user gets no feedback. Show a toast.
ConvUpdate.notes and form_answers accept arbitrary dicts. Only a str(upd) length cap of 100k is applied. Consider typing them as Dict[str, str] and Dict[str, {facts, answer}].

SellerForms onSave sends the whole form_answers dict on every blur (last write wins). This is fine for a single tab, but two devices editing at once will overwrite each other. Consider a $set on form_answers.<key>.
conv_suggest refunds the counter on LLM failure (good), and the atomic $lt filter prevents racing past the limit (verified: count stays at 3 after the 402).
seed_data_creation: None kept. Test moves were deleted. users.conv_suggest_count was unset for test@advocate.app at the end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: UI login: go to the site (it redirects to /welcome.html), set localStorage aa_token (from POST /api/auth/login access_token), aa_terms=1, aa_cookie_consent=essential, aa_welcomed=1, aa_uk_scope_ack=1, aa_lex_upl_ack=1, sessionStorage aa_splash_seen=1, then page.goto(base + '/'). Running page.reload() on welcome.html does NOT work. To test the free limit cheaply, set users.conv_suggest_count=2 in Mongo so a single LLM call reaches 0 left and the next call returns 402.
